The deal brings Kard into a part of Citi that is expanding how it connects cardholders with merchant-funded offers. The acquisition is intended to help Citi deliver more personalised credit card rewards and offers while creating new ways for merchants to reach consumers. Kard operates a platform that matches offers with consumers based on verified transaction data, used by banks, fintechs, and neobanks.
